description: Average Annual Weekday Traffic Volumes (2011-2022) is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. Actual volumes and estimated volumes are displayed. Estimated volumes are derived from growth factors at permanent counting sites. The growth factors are applied to the most recent actual AAWDT volume at a given location. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are volumes, aawdt, traffic. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2023-10-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
